question_text: Jose finishes a report in 5h, Pedro in 3h. Together, how long?

hint_ladder.title: Rates
hint_ladder.text: Rate ni Jose: 1/5 report kada oras. Rate ni Pedro: 1/3 kada oras. Combined: 1/5 + 1/3.

hint_ladder.title: Combined
hint_ladder.text: I-fraction: 1/5 = 3/15, 1/3 = 5/15. Combined rate = 8/15 ng report per hour.

hint_ladder.title: Answer
hint_ladder.text: 15/8 = 1.875 hours. 'Yan ang tamang sagot, letra C.

A.text: You might have chosen A because you averaged the times (5+3)/2=4 then halved it, but rates don't work that way.

B.text: You might have chosen B because you miscalculated 15/8 as 1.75 instead of 1.875.

C.text: Correct. Combined rate = 8/15 per hour, so time = 15/8 = 1.875 hours.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you halved the average time of 4, forgetting to use the reciprocal sum.

next_time_rule: Key Takeaway: For combined work, use 1/t = 1/a + 1/b. Never average the times.
deconstruct_text:
Isipin natin: Sina Jose at Pedro, nag-ta-trabaho sa barangay para i-process ang isang tambak na clearance forms.

**Step 1: Alamin ang indibidwal na sipag.**
Si Jose: 1 buong report sa 5 oras → rate = 1/5 bawat oras. Si Pedro: 1 report sa 3 oras → rate = 1/3 bawat oras.

**Step 2: Pagsamahin ang rates.**
Combined rate = 1/5 + 1/3 = 3/15 + 5/15 = 8/15 ng report kada oras.

**Step 3: Oras kapag magkasama.**
Oras = 1 report ÷ (8/15 report per hour) = 15/8 = 1.875 hours.

**Step 4: Bakit mali ang ibang sagot.**
'Yung 1.5 (A) at 2 (D)? Galing 'yan sa pag-average ng 5 at 3 — huwag! Ang 1.75 (B) naman, palpak na division lang.

**Watch-Out Zone: reverse_operation_error** in action. Don't average; use 1/(1/5+1/3)=1...
